授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
The lessons will be conducted in-person (may also be online if necessary).
Important Note:
This subject is limited to about 25 students in the class. But the number of students may increase to accommodate all Design Innovation International Program students.
Students not in the Design Innovation International Program can also take this subject as elective.
If the number of students registered for this subject exceeds the limit, we will implement the following process to determine who can enroll.
Registration for study:
1. All students who registered for this subject should attend the first lesson. The absence of students from the first lesson will be interpreted as their decision to abandon the study of this subject.
2. Please note that this subject is part of the subjects in the Design Innovation International Program (DIIP). Therefore, all DIIP students who have registered for this subject will receive priority.
3. After allocating the places for all DIIP students, the remaining available places to study this subject will be divided equally among international exchange students in the School of Design and students at the School of Design and other schools in Kyushu University.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 授業の目的は、本学がどのような知的財産権支援を行っているかを基本的に理解することである。これにより、学生は大学の知的財産権支援制度などを活用し、国内外でのデザイン活動を行うことができるようになります。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: The objective of this course is to provide students with the basic understand on the kind of Intellectual Property Rights support provided by the university. In doing so, students may be able to conduct their design activities locally and globally by leveraging on the IPR support systems in the university.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: intellectual property rights (IPR), entrepreneurship, start-up protection
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: Please be prepared to discuss topics in English.

授業科目に関する学習相談について.合理的配慮について:
障害(難病・慢性疾患含む)があり、通常の方法による授業を受けることが困難な場合には、教育目的の本質的な変更など過重な負担を伴わない限り、合理的配慮を受けることができます。合理的配慮とは、教授・学習法の変更、成績評価の方法の変更、授業情報の保障(資料の字幕化、個別の資料配布、録音・撮影の許可)、受講環境の調整などを指します。実際の方法については担当教員と建設的対話を行った上で決定されます。
